select:
/* HcpApiMyPageMapper.getMyAllApi : 나의 구독 API 목록 조회 */
WITH MY_KEY_IDS AS ( SELECT DISTINCT HAK.KEY_ID, HAK.KEY_NAME, HAKA.AUTH_CD, HAKA.PRJ_ID, HAKA.AUTH_ID FROM HCP_API_KEY HAK JOIN HCP_API_KEY_AUTH HAKA ON HAKA.KEY_ID = HAK.KEY_ID
JOIN TABLE(HCP_GET_AUTH_PRJ(#{empNo})) PRJ ON PRJ.PRJ_ID = HAKA.PRJ_ID
WHERE NOT ( HAKA.AUTH_CD = 'PSN' AND HAK.OWNER_ID != #{empNo} )
AND HAK.KEY_ID IN
#{item}
),
STATUS_INFO AS ( /* * 권한 요청 상태 * * 목록 한 행 기준: * SVC_ID + KEY_ID + REQ_STAT_CD */ SELECT R.SVC_ID, R.KEY_ID, 'NONE' AS SUB_STAT_CD, 'AUTH_' || R.REQ_STAT_CD AS REQ_STAT_CD,
MAX(R.REG_USER_ID) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY R.UPD_DTTM, R.REG_USER_ID ) AS REG_USER_ID,
MAX(R.UPD_DTTM) AS UPD_DTTM
FROM HCP_API_SVC_REQ R
WHERE R.REQ_STAT_CD != 'NOR'
GROUP BY R.SVC_ID, R.KEY_ID, R.REQ_STAT_CD
UNION ALL
/* * 구독 상태 * * 목록 한 행 기준: * SVC_ID + KEY_ID + SUB_STAT_CD */ SELECT B.SVC_ID, SUB.KEY_ID, 'SUB_' || SUB.SUB_STAT_CD AS SUB_STAT_CD, 'NONE' AS REQ_STAT_CD,
MAX(SUB.REG_USER_ID) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY SUB.UPD_DTTM, SUB.REG_USER_ID ) AS REG_USER_ID,
MAX(SUB.UPD_DTTM) AS UPD_DTTM
FROM HCP_API_SUB SUB JOIN HCP_API_PUB P ON P.PUB_ID = SUB.PUB_ID JOIN HCP_API_BASE B ON B.API_ID = P.API_ID
WHERE SUB.SUB_STAT_CD != 'CCL'
GROUP BY B.SVC_ID, SUB.KEY_ID, SUB.SUB_STAT_CD ),
/* * 서비스별 구독 Key 수 */ SUB_COUNT_INFO AS ( SELECT B.SVC_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT SUB.KEY_ID) AS SUB_COUNT
FROM HCP_API_SUB SUB JOIN HCP_API_PUB P ON P.PUB_ID = SUB.PUB_ID JOIN HCP_API_BASE B ON B.API_ID = P.API_ID
WHERE SUB.SUB_STAT_CD != 'CCL'
GROUP BY B.SVC_ID )
SELECT S.SVC_ID, S.SVC_NM, S.SVC_TYPE, S.SVC_MODEL, S.SVC_DESC,
ST.UPD_DTTM, ST.REG_USER_ID,
ST.SUB_STAT_CD, ST.REQ_STAT_CD,
CASE WHEN ST.SUB_STAT_CD != 'NONE' THEN ST.SUB_STAT_CD WHEN ST.REQ_STAT_CD != 'NONE' THEN ST.REQ_STAT_CD ELSE 'NONE' END AS STAT_CD,
NVL(FU.NAME_KOR, '-') AS NAME_KOR, FU.EMAIL, FD.NAME_KOR AS DEPT_KOR, FP.NAME_KOR AS POS_KOR,
ST.REG_USER_ID AS EMP_NO,
NVL(SCI.SUB_COUNT, 0) AS SUB_COUNT,
MKI.KEY_ID, MKI.KEY_NAME, MKI.AUTH_CD, MKI.PRJ_ID, MKI.AUTH_ID
FROM STATUS_INFO ST
JOIN MY_KEY_IDS MKI ON MKI.KEY_ID = ST.KEY_ID
JOIN HCP_API_SVC S ON S.SVC_ID = ST.SVC_ID AND S.SVC_ENV = '${hcp.application.env}'
LEFT JOIN SUB_COUNT_INFO SCI ON SCI.SVC_ID = ST.SVC_ID
LEFT JOIN FR_USER FU ON FU.EMP_NO = ST.REG_USER_ID AND FU.STATUS_CD = 'C'
LEFT JOIN FR_DEPT FD ON FD.DEPT_ID = FU.DEPT_ID
LEFT JOIN FR_POSITION FP ON FP.PSTN_ID = FU.PSTN_ID
WHERE S.SHOW_YN = 'Y'
AND ( S.DEL_YN = 'N' OR ( S.DEL_YN = 'Y' AND S.RES_DTTM >= SYSDATE ) )
AND S.SVC_TYPE = UPPER(#{svcType})
AND LOWER(S.SVC_NM) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{search}) || '%'
AND ( ST.SUB_STAT_CD = UPPER(#{subStatus}) OR ST.REQ_STAT_CD = UPPER(#{subStatus}) )
ORDER BY
SUB_COUNT
S.SVC_NM
S.SVC_TYPE
MKI.KEY_NAME
ST.UPD_DTTM
ASC
DESC

/* HcpApiMyPageMapper.getMyReqCount : 나의 권한 요청 상태별 서비스/Key 건수 */
WITH MY_KEY_IDS AS ( SELECT DISTINCT HAK.KEY_ID
FROM HCP_API_KEY HAK JOIN HCP_API_KEY_AUTH HAKA ON HAKA.KEY_ID = HAK.KEY_ID
JOIN TABLE(HCP_GET_AUTH_PRJ(#{empNo})) PRJ ON PRJ.PRJ_ID = HAKA.PRJ_ID
WHERE NOT ( HAKA.AUTH_CD = 'PSN' AND HAK.OWNER_ID != #{empNo} )
AND HAK.KEY_ID IN
#{item}
)
SELECT COUNT(1)
FROM ( SELECT R.SVC_ID, R.KEY_ID, R.REQ_STAT_CD
FROM HCP_API_SVC_REQ R
JOIN HCP_API_SVC S ON S.SVC_ID = R.SVC_ID AND S.SVC_ENV = '${hcp.application.env}'
JOIN MY_KEY_IDS MKI ON MKI.KEY_ID = R.KEY_ID
WHERE S.SHOW_YN = 'Y'
AND ( S.DEL_YN = 'N' OR ( S.DEL_YN = 'Y' AND S.RES_DTTM >= SYSDATE ) )
AND S.SVC_TYPE = UPPER(#{svcType})
/* * DB에는 APR, REJ 형태로 저장 * AUTH_APR 전체값을 직접 넘기면 안 됨 */
AND R.REQ_STAT_CD = UPPER(#{keyword})
AND LOWER(S.SVC_NM) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{search}) || '%'
GROUP BY R.SVC_ID, R.KEY_ID, R.REQ_STAT_CD ) REQUEST_STATUS
